root_cause.text: The f81604 CAN USB driver lacked a length check on received interrupt URBs, allowing processing of incomplete data when the URB's actual length was less than the expected data structure size, which could lead to out-of-bounds reads or other undefined behavior.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (urb->actual_length < sizeof(*data))` with a warning and a `goto resubmit_urb`, preventing further processing of short URBs. The commit message states the need to "properly detect and don't attempt to treat the data as valid."

intent_record.intent_summary: Added guard to check URB data length to prevent out-of-bounds access on short interrupt transfers.
intent_record.what: Added a check for urb->actual_length < sizeof(*data) before the switch statement; if true, logs a warning and jumps to resubmit_urb.
intent_record.how: The driver now validates that the received URB data length is at least the size of the expected structure, preventing out-of-bounds reads and causing resubmission on short transfers.
